documented_probe: Documented probe waiver: C-e87edf52 (R Jupyter kernel + R causal-analysis packages) appears at hard floor in reference evidence; the v2 task exercises the kernel/package provisioning at medium difficulty with verifier-checked kernel execution, intentionally kept lean (container install budget).
notes: Scoped as a medium environment-repair task. The seven broken components are independent, but the pyros path is genuinely dependent (port build off the numpy 2.x-removed numpy.distutils, compile against the installed numpy 2.x, install, and only then import) and the R kernel requires R->IRkernel->kernelspec registration in sequence (dependent_stages=2). Each capability is diagnosed from a distinct failure signature rather than one shared symptom (debugging_ambiguity=2). The hidden cases are edge/malformed inputs (empty arrays, negative k, tab/unicode digests, bogus FERN_GL_LIB dirs) that the repaired packages must generalize to (hidden_case_generalization=2, adversarial_inputs=2). Numeric checks (digest hex, ring sums, flows sums) are exact (quantitative_correctness=1). Everything runs offline from vendored sources; no GPU/X/service; agent timeout 1200s is enough for the compile + R kernel registration.
